perf.done_hint: Filled in from your sub-plan results above; add to it or change it.
perf.reference: Suggested from your sub-plans by share: {pct}
perf.self_approves: Your results take effect when submitted; no review is needed.
perf.state_note.submitted: Submitted on {at}, waiting for review. Withdraw it if you need to change it.

perf.state_note.withdrawn: Withdrawn. Change it and submit again when ready.

perf.rv.reason_shared: The same reason is used for all {n}
perf.rv.edit_hint: You can change the % and the text directly; the submitted version stays in the history.

perf.err.not_assignee: Only assignees can write results for this task
perf.err.locked: These results are submitted; withdraw them before changing
perf.err.withdraw_approved: Approved results cannot be withdrawn; ask your head to return them
perf.err.not_pending: The status has changed; please refresh
perf.err.file_locked: Attachments of submitted or approved results cannot be deleted
perf.err.delete_has_results: This plan or its sub-plans have submitted or approved results, so it cannot be deleted. Withdraw them first; approved results must be returned by your head first.
